text:
deploy-bot: Rollout v2026.04.02-beta -> production started (canary 5% apac2). Post-deploy synthetic run kicked off. Report: https://deploys.redwood.internal/3491123456

elena: getting alerts from qa-bot: embed-route probes in apac2 returning shortened payloads and missing x-request-trace header. Probe: emb-quick-11.

tom: how many failures?

qa-bot: Summary: window 5m, total probes 40, failures 6 (15%), missing header on all failures. Logs: https://qa.redwood.internal/synth/emb-quick-11/3491123456

elena: missing x-request-trace causes our telemetry to drop the sample so aggregations show skewed success. But user-facing body also truncated.

infra-bot: Observability: `smoke.synthetic_body_truncation{region=\"apac2\",route=\"/embed\"}` alert fired at 2026-04-02T02:10:12Z.

tom: this release changed the http-proxy upstream header handling (strip-proxy-headers=false -> true) for canaries. Could be the culprit.

elena: options: rollback canary fully, pin apac2 to stable, or hotfix proxy config and redeploy canary. Which minimizes risk?

ops-oncall: ping ops@oncall. If telemetry is impacted we should pin region to stable to avoid noisy metrics. Customer impact unknown.

qa-bot: running an expanded sample: emb-quick-11 x 200 probes in apac2 now to baseline.

tom: if strip-proxy-headers is the cause, hotfix is trivial (flip flag) but needs canary redeploy and quick smoke. If we pin region, we avoid redeploy complexity.

elena: I'd prefer pin apac2 to stable, then push hotfix to canary and validate in staging before re-ramping.

ops-oncall: Approving regional pin. Execute: `/pin-route --region apac2 --route /embed --target v2026.03.30-stable --reason "post-deploy synth truncation, header strip change"`

infra-bot: Command executed and approved by ops-oncall: apac2 embed-route pinned to v2026.03.30-stable. Traffic verified: `curl -sS https://routes.prod/status?route=embed&region=apac2` -> `v2026.03.30-stable (pinned)`

qa-bot: expanded sample complete: 200 probes -> 33 failures before pin (16.5%). Expecting reduction after pin.

tom: creating Jira RD-4822 "embed synth truncation in apac2 due to header stripping" and assigning runtime/proxy teams.

elena: release notes update: under v2026.04.02-beta include note: "apac2 embed-route temporarily pinned to v2026.03.30-stable after synthetic probes detected truncated payloads and telemetry header loss; rollout paused for apac2 while teams investigate."

ops-oncall: change window note: hold ramp for full rollout until 09:30 UTC or resolution. Owner: elena.

infra-bot: summary actions: pin applied, expanded sampling running, Jira RD-4822 created (https://jira.redwood.internal/browse/RD-4822), rollout paused for apac2.

elena: thanks. I'll coordinate proxy config revert in staging and post results here. Keeping thread open until close.

qa-bot: will post new synth numbers by 02:25Z.

tom: thx all :thumbsup:
